resources.string: Pin your devices\' programs in Programs: long-press a program.
Add an app to favourites in Programs: long-press the app.
Safeer OS as your home screen?
The Home button will then bring you here. You can return to your previous launcher at any time: Settings → Home screen. Safeer OS also works as a normal app.
Safeer OS stopped twice in a row as the home screen, so the Home button opens your previous launcher again. You can set it up again whenever you like.
Safeer OS as your launcher: the Home button opens Safeer OS. Turning it off restores your previous launcher immediately.
A number on an app icon only for messages, calls and reminders – not for background services. Turn on notification access in Android settings.
Your previous launcher is the home screen again.
